product_metadata.title: Nasema Kitchen 6-Piece Ceramic Coasters for Drinks Absorbent with Cork Scratch Protection, 4-Inches Navy Blue and Gold Marble Lines for Cups and Glasses

With a modern and colorful coaster, you don't have to worry about spilling liquid from your coffee or cold drink nor scratching your table!

★ EVERYONE REMEMBERS! – Just like all of us tend to remember people we see dressed in elegance and style we also love and remember vibrant and colorful decoration. Make the room light up and the gathering more vibrant and fun with a beautiful combination of navy blue and gold marble lines.

★ PUT A SMILE ON THAT FACE! – Unlike cheap and light silicone or plastic you want a nice weight and fine finish to your coasters. Surprise your husband or wife, or why not the bridal couple, with a heartwarming gift of quality. It’s hard to go wrong with a memorable and unique gift that suits both men and women, young and old.
